Defects #139 and #140. A task run whose agent process died stays running forever: the boot reaper settles the agent's own run row but never the task's attempt row, so open-run counts keep counting it and the task reads as in flight. The attempt should settle from the same event that settles its agent. Separately, the queued task status has no inbound transition, so no task can ever reach it, yet the board, graph lanes and in-flight checks still treat it as a live state. Every status the lifecycle lists should be reachable, or leave the list.
